sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Header and purpose of the background
sections.what: Declares the file as browser-only and describes the background as code fragments and pixel blocks in horizontal bands. It notes that the bands can be streamed sideways during a time-travel transition.
sections.why: The header comment states what the background is for. The reason for the design is not stated beyond the transition effect.
sections.watch_out: The speed value is in pixels per second, so changing its meaning would change the speed of every transition.

sections.name: TOKENS
sections.title: Decorative word fragments
sections.what: A fixed list of short technical words, symbols and fragments that drift across the background as faint text.
sections.why: Likely reason: adds a coding-style texture behind the experience section.
sections.watch_out: Some entries use symbols outside basic letters, which depend on the font having those characters.

sections.name: Band
sections.title: Shape of one background row
sections.what: Describes one horizontal row of background items: its height, its speed, the items placed along it, and its width.
sections.why: Gives the drawing code a clear structure for the rows it builds.

sections.name: rng
sections.title: Repeatable random numbers
sections.what: Produces a stream of numbers from a fixed starting value, so the background looks the same on every visit and after every resize.
sections.why: Likely reason: a repeatable pattern looks deliberate, not random on each load.
sections.watch_out: Changing the starting value (17 in the build code) changes the whole pattern.

sections.name: GlyphField (part 1)
sections.title: Building the background rows
sections.what: Lays out rows and items to fill the canvas at the current size, and rebuilds them whenever the canvas changes size.
sections.why: Rows are built once and reused, so each frame only moves and draws them.
sections.watch_out: The canvas uses the screen pixel ratio capped at 2, which keeps it sharp without too much cost.

sections.name: GlyphField (part 2)
sections.title: Animation loop
sections.what: Each frame, moves the background items according to the section's scroll speed, sets their brightness, and draws text, filled boxes or lines. It stops drawing when the section is off-screen.
sections.why: Stopping when hidden saves processing and battery.
sections.watch_out: With reduced motion on, the constant base drift is removed, so the background moves only when the section does.
